The [[Moa Bird]] is a [[charmable animal]] that is found in [[Ascalon]]. In [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]] they were known as '''Striders'''.

==Notes==
*Evolved Moa Birds deal [[piercing damage]], while unevolved Moa Birds deal [[slashing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''
**Turning in a Strider from [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]] unlocks the Moa.
*The Moa Birds found outside Umbral Grotto are labeled as [[ally]] (light green label color) instead of a charmable animal and do not turn hostile upon activation of [[Charm Animal]].
*One of the [[Mysterious Tonic]]'s forms.
*[[Black Moa]]s and uncharmable [[Sickened Moa]]s can be found in [[Cantha]].
*[[White Moa]]s can be found in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]].
{{anomaly|Moa Birds [[Attack speed|attack faster]] than most other pets (~1.5 seconds/attack versus 2 seconds/attack). This does not include Striders which attack at the normal 2 seconds/attack.}}
{{bug|[[Strider]]s can sometimes be bugged so that they do not evolve into aggressive/dire as of 2014 and stay unevolved, even when death-leveled.}}

==Trivia==
*[[w:Moa|Moa]] is the name of a flightless bird that, until it was hunted to extinction by the local Maori, occupied the country of New Zealand. In appearance, the moas of Guild Wars resemble the [[w:Phorusrhacidae|Phorusrhacids]], predatory flightless birds that used to inhabit the Americas.
